tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground and the work area. Everything sits on it; never tint it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the timeline rail, the board columns. Separated from surface by border, not shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code, the terminal pane ground, inputs, the packet's raw JSON.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline (1px) borders on cards, rows, columns and inputs. In stage it is strong enough to carry structure on its own (3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and focus-within borders, the approval gate's top rule, table header rules.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (16:1 light, 18:1 dark, 21:1 stage).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, labels, descriptions, the tagline. 7.5:1 on surface in light, 8:1 in dark, 15:1 in stage.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholder, disabled labels, the event tail. 4.8:1 on surface in light; never below 12px.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: the primary button, the live run's segment and chip, focus ring, links. 5.2:1 on surface in light, 7.1:1 in stage.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Dark theme lightens the accent, so the text goes dark (8.6:1).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected row, the live segment's background, the accent chip's background. Always with ink or accent text, never on-accent.

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: Verified, approved, passed, merged. Text and marks on surface (4.9:1 light, 10:1 dark, 7.2:1 stage) and on status-good-tint. Always paired with a word or icon; told apart from status-bad by lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: status-good-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the green verification card and the approved chip; status-good or ink text on it.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Awaiting approval, capped, killed, needs you. Text and marks on surface (5.0:1 light, 11:1 dark, 7.3:1 stage) and on status-warn-tint.

tokens.name: status-warn-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the amber killed segment and the needs-you lane header.

tokens.name: status-bad
tokens.usage: Failed verification, blocked review, rejected. Text and marks on surface (5.9:1 light, 7.6:1 dark, 7.9:1 stage) and on status-bad-tint.

tokens.name: status-bad-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a failed verification card and a blocker row.

tokens.name: vendor-meta
tokens.usage: Muse (Meta) vendor mark fill and rail segment. Only on the two-letter mark and the timeline segment, never on body text.

tokens.name: vendor-alt
tokens.usage: Stint agent mark fill and rail segment.

tokens.name: vendor-openai
tokens.usage: Codex vendor mark fill and rail segment (post-hackathon).

tokens.name: vendor-local
tokens.usage: Local open models (Ollama, Glimmer) vendor mark fill and rail segment.

tokens.name: on-mark
tokens.usage: The two letters on a vendor mark. Marks are 20px bold, so 3:1 is the floor; every vendor fill meets 4.5:1 with on-mark in every theme.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring outside the control, 3:1 on every surface. Never removed.

tokens.name: diff-added
tokens.usage: Added-line background in the diff viewer, ink text on it.

tokens.name: diff-removed
tokens.usage: Removed-line background in the diff viewer, ink text on it.

tokens.name: terminal-ground
tokens.usage: The xterm pane background in every theme; terminal text is terminal-ink.

tokens.name: terminal-ink
tokens.usage: Default terminal foreground on terminal-ground (13:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one display line per screen: the task title in the task view, the board's week total.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section titles and card titles that are the page's subject.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card headers, column headers, the run segment header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Added a sliding-window limiter and wired it into the router.
styles.usage: Default UI text: summaries, descriptions, table cells, list items.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body: counts, the verdict, the holder's name.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: 2 min ago · run by the daemon
styles.usage: Metadata under a title: timestamps, provenance, the cost line. ink-muted.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Chip and badge text. Never below this size; never uppercase tracking.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: File paths, commands, the diff, the packet JSON, the event tail.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard hints in buttons and the palette, inside a surface-sunken pill with a border.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The grid unit. Gap between a mark and its label, chip padding vertical.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding horizontal, gap between chips, row padding vertical.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on dense cards, gap between timeline rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, column gutters, the page's side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a column.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a panel; the rail's left inset.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Row height of board cards' header, the rail segment header height, the gate's height.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top bar height; gap between major regions.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, kbd pills, inline code, diff line markers.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, vendor marks, cards inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the terminal pane, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, the timeline's joints, the scrubber thumb.

shadow.note: Stint uses borders, not shadows. The one shadow is for floating layers.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: The command palette, menus and toasts only. In stage it becomes a solid 2px outline.
